# Obtain the company tax identifiers

[Overview](#overview) · [Before you start](#before-you-start) · [Geography](#geography) · [Steps](#steps-at-a-glance) · [Outputs](#outputs)

## Overview

Obtain or confirm the tax identifiers needed by the company. Some jurisdictions issue them during incorporation; others require a separate application or tax registration.

> Additional country launch entry points source-checked 2026-10-30. These are draft scoping summaries. They do not establish complete local-law workflows, professional review or verified execution for those countries.

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Kind | process |
| Phase | formation |
| Cadence | once |
| Geo scope | global |
| Complexity | simple |
| Reversibility | hard to undo |
| Active work | ~12 min |
| Elapsed including waits | ~12 min |
| Agent support | manual guide |

IRS EIN application is a web form with no API. System provides step-by-step guidance and pre-fills company data.

- Sources: [KVK Business Register and Tax Administration](https://www.kvk.nl/en/starting/business-register-and-tax-administration/) · [Revenue registering for tax](https://www.revenue.ie/en/starting-a-business/registering-for-tax/index.aspx) · [Agencia Tributaria tax census and NIF](https://sede.agenciatributaria.gob.es/Sede/censos-nif-domicilio-fiscal/censos.html) · [Skatteverket starting and registering a business](https://www.skatteverket.se/foretag/drivaforetag/startaochregistrera.4.58d555751259e4d661680006123.html) · [Swiss Federal Tax Administration VAT registration](https://www.estv.admin.ch/en/register-for-vat) · [Japan National Tax Agency notification guidelines](https://www.nta.go.jp/english/Guidelines.htm) · [Brazil register an entity in CNPJ](https://www.gov.br/pt-br/servicos/inscrever-no-cnpj) · [UAE Federal Tax Authority corporate tax registration](https://tax.gov.ae/en/services/corporate.tax.registration.aspx)

## Step details

<a id="step-1"></a>

### 1. Prepare the company tax-registration information

agent-runnable · ~1 min


Collect the legal entity details and existing registration records. Determine which tax identifiers were issued at formation and what additional registration is required by the company’s jurisdiction. Keep identifiers and responsible-person details in the private workspace.

- Sources: [IRS get an EIN](https://www.irs.gov/businesses/small-businesses-self-employed/get-an-employer-identification-number)

<a id="step-2"></a>

### 2. Obtain or confirm the company tax identifiers

manual form/portal · ~10 min · hard to undo


Check the accepted formation documents for identifiers already issued. Where a separate application is required, use the local tax authority’s procedure after authorized review. Save the confirmation and identify any additional tax programme accounts.

- Verify: Retain the official confirmation or accepted documents required for this step in the selected jurisdiction; reconcile them with the approved company records.
- Produces: EIN assignment letter
- Canonical vendor: IRS
- Do it yourself: [IRS EIN online application](https://www.irs.gov/businesses/small-businesses-self-employed/apply-for-an-employer-identification-number-ein-online)
- Sources: [IRS get an EIN](https://www.irs.gov/businesses/small-businesses-self-employed/get-an-employer-identification-number) · [KVK Business Register and Tax Administration](https://www.kvk.nl/en/starting/business-register-and-tax-administration/) · [Revenue registering for tax](https://www.revenue.ie/en/starting-a-business/registering-for-tax/index.aspx) · [Agencia Tributaria tax census and NIF](https://sede.agenciatributaria.gob.es/Sede/censos-nif-domicilio-fiscal/censos.html) · [Skatteverket starting and registering a business](https://www.skatteverket.se/foretag/drivaforetag/startaochregistrera.4.58d555751259e4d661680006123.html) · [Swiss Federal Tax Administration VAT registration](https://www.estv.admin.ch/en/register-for-vat) · [Japan National Tax Agency notification guidelines](https://www.nta.go.jp/english/Guidelines.htm) · [Brazil register an entity in CNPJ](https://www.gov.br/pt-br/servicos/inscrever-no-cnpj) · [UAE Federal Tax Authority corporate tax registration](https://tax.gov.ae/en/services/corporate.tax.registration.aspx)

<a id="step-3"></a>

### 3. Store the tax identifiers in company records

agent-runnable · ~1 min


Store the verified identifiers, issuing authority and confirmation privately. Make them available only to authorized users and downstream filings that require them.

- Sources: [IRS get an EIN](https://www.irs.gov/businesses/small-businesses-self-employed/get-an-employer-identification-number)


<a id="by-country"></a>

## Country details

<a id="geo-us"></a>

### United States

- Step 1: Pre-fill EIN application data Apply for an Employer Identification Number (EIN) from the IRS for the newly incorporated company. Collect the legal name, formation details and address from the accepted entity documents. Identify the responsible party, business activity, tax classification and reason for applying. Check whether an EIN already exists and which IRS application channel the entity can use. Resolve uncertain answers with the responsible person before filing, and keep tax identifiers in the private application workspace.
- Step 2: Complete IRS SS-4 form online Use the IRS application method for which the entity and responsible party qualify. Review the answers against the prepared facts and current instructions. The authorized representative approves submission; a third-party designee needs signed authorization. Complete the required identity or signature steps and save the IRS confirmation. If the applicant is ineligible for the online assistant, use the appropriate IRS alternative with accurate identity details. ([IRS EIN online application](https://www.irs.gov/businesses/small-businesses-self-employed/apply-for-an-employer-identification-number-ein-online))
  - Cost: free (free, as of 2026-10-01, [www.irs.gov](https://www.irs.gov/businesses/small-businesses-self-employed/apply-for-an-employer-identification-number-ein-online)). The IRS issues EINs for free; third-party services charge to file on your behalf.
  - Verify: The EIN is issued in the XX-XXXXXXX format at the end of the online session — retain the CP 575 confirmation notice; banks and payroll providers ask for it. ([www.irs.gov](https://www.irs.gov/businesses/small-businesses-self-employed/apply-for-an-employer-identification-number-ein-online))

<a id="geo-in"></a>

### India

- Absorbed: PAN and TAN — the company's tax identifiers — are allotted automatically as part of the SPICe+ incorporation filing; the Income Tax e-filing portal is where the company then uses them. ([Income Tax e-filing portal (PAN/TAN)](https://www.incometax.gov.in/iec/foportal/))
- Step 2: Absorbed: PAN and TAN — the company's tax identifiers — are allotted automatically as part of the SPICe+ incorporation filing; the Income Tax e-filing portal is where the company then uses them. ([Income Tax e-filing portal (PAN/TAN)](https://www.incometax.gov.in/iec/foportal/))

<a id="geo-uk"></a>

### United Kingdom

- Absorbed: There is no EIN application: HMRC posts the company a Unique Taxpayer Reference (UTR) automatically after incorporation, and you register for Corporation Tax within 3 months of starting business. ([HMRC Corporation Tax (UTR)](https://www.gov.uk/corporation-tax))
- Step 2: Absorbed: There is no EIN application: HMRC posts the company a Unique Taxpayer Reference (UTR) automatically after incorporation, and you register for Corporation Tax within 3 months of starting business. ([HMRC Corporation Tax (UTR)](https://www.gov.uk/corporation-tax))

<a id="geo-de"></a>

### Germany

- The tax office issues a Steuernummer after you file the Fragebogen zur steuerlichen Erfassung (tax registration questionnaire) on ELSTER — plus a separate VAT ID from the BZSt if needed. ([ELSTER — tax office registration](https://www.elster.de/eportal/start))
- Step 2: The tax office issues a Steuernummer after you file the Fragebogen zur steuerlichen Erfassung (tax registration questionnaire) on ELSTER — plus a separate VAT ID from the BZSt if needed. ([ELSTER — tax office registration](https://www.elster.de/eportal/start))

<a id="geo-fr"></a>

### France

- Absorbed: No application: INSEE allots the SIREN (company) and SIRET (per-establishment) identifiers automatically when the guichet unique registration lands — they arrive with the company's registration. ([Obtain a SIREN/SIRET number](https://entreprendre.service-public.fr/vosdroits/F32135))
- Step 2: Absorbed: No application: INSEE allots the SIREN (company) and SIRET (per-establishment) identifiers automatically when the guichet unique registration lands — they arrive with the company's registration. ([Obtain a SIREN/SIRET number](https://entreprendre.service-public.fr/vosdroits/F32135))

<a id="geo-pt"></a>

### Portugal

- Absorbed: No separate tax-ID application: the NIPC issued at incorporation is the company's tax number (NIF), and filing the declaração de início de atividade with the tax authority activates it for corporate tax and VAT. ([Portal das Finanças (AT)](https://www.portaldasfinancas.gov.pt/))
- Step 2: Absorbed: No separate tax-ID application: the NIPC issued at incorporation is the company's tax number (NIF), and filing the declaração de início de atividade with the tax authority activates it for corporate tax and VAT. ([Portal das Finanças (AT)](https://www.portaldasfinancas.gov.pt/))

<a id="geo-ca"></a>

### Canada

- Absorbed: A CRA business number is issued automatically with federal (and most provincial) incorporation — you add program accounts to it (payroll RP, GST/HST RT, corporate tax RC) through Business Registration Online rather than applying for a separate tax ID. ([CRA — business number registration](https://www.canada.ca/en/revenue-agency/services/tax/businesses/topics/registering-your-business.html))
- Step 2: Absorbed: A CRA business number is issued automatically with federal (and most provincial) incorporation — you add program accounts to it (payroll RP, GST/HST RT, corporate tax RC) through Business Registration Online rather than applying for a separate tax ID. ([CRA — business number registration](https://www.canada.ca/en/revenue-agency/services/tax/businesses/topics/registering-your-business.html))

<a id="geo-nz"></a>

### New Zealand

- Absorbed: No separate tax-ID application: the Companies Office incorporation application lets you choose to register for an Inland Revenue (IRD) number, a GST number, and as an employer in the same filing. ([Incorporating a company — Companies Register](https://companies-register.companiesoffice.govt.nz/help-centre/starting-a-company/incorporating-a-company/))
- Step 2: Absorbed: No separate tax-ID application: the Companies Office incorporation application lets you choose to register for an Inland Revenue (IRD) number, a GST number, and as an employer in the same filing. ([Incorporating a company — Companies Register](https://companies-register.companiesoffice.govt.nz/help-centre/starting-a-company/incorporating-a-company/))

<a id="geo-sg"></a>

### Singapore

- Absorbed: There is no EIN application: ACRA assigns the company's UEN at incorporation and it is the identification number across Singapore government agencies, IRAS included — tax filings simply run on it. ([Bizfile (ACRA)](https://www.bizfile.gov.sg/))
- Step 2: Absorbed: There is no EIN application: ACRA assigns the company's UEN at incorporation and it is the identification number across Singapore government agencies, IRAS included — tax filings simply run on it. ([Bizfile (ACRA)](https://www.bizfile.gov.sg/))

<a id="geo-au"></a>

### Australia

- The tax identifiers are a real application: the company applies to the Australian Business Register for an ABN (the company TFN rides the same flow), and most founders file it inside the Business Registration Service alongside the ASIC company registration (law rule [au.abn-registration](../../open-law/AU/au-abn-registration.json)). ([Register for an ABN](https://business.gov.au/registrations/register-for-an-australian-business-number-abn))
- Step 2: The tax identifiers are a real application: the company applies to the Australian Business Register for an ABN (the company TFN rides the same flow), and most founders file it inside the Business Registration Service alongside the ASIC company registration (law rule au.abn-registration). ([Register for an ABN](https://business.gov.au/registrations/register-for-an-australian-business-number-abn))

<a id="geo-kr"></a>

### South Korea

- The tax identity is the business registration number (사업자등록번호), applied for with the district tax office within 20 days of starting business and available before the start date (Value-Added Tax Act Article 8); corporations file it through Hometax after the registry incorporation. ([Hometax (NTS e-filing)](https://www.hometax.go.kr/))
- Step 2: The tax identity is the business registration number (사업자등록번호), applied for with the district tax office within 20 days of starting business and available before the start date (Value-Added Tax Act Article 8); corporations file it through Hometax after the registry incorporation. ([Hometax (NTS e-filing)](https://www.hometax.go.kr/))

<a id="geo-hk"></a>

### Hong Kong

- Absorbed: There is no separate application: the one-stop incorporation files the Notice to Business Registration Office (IRBR1) with the NNC1, so the business registration certificate — whose number doubles as the company's tax reference — issues together with the certificate of incorporation (law rule [hk.business-registration-certificate](../../open-law/HK/hk-business-registration-certificate.json)). ([IRD — business registration](https://www.ird.gov.hk/eng/tax/bre.htm))
- Step 2: Absorbed: There is no separate application: the one-stop incorporation files the Notice to Business Registration Office (IRBR1) with the NNC1, so the business registration certificate — whose number doubles as the company's tax reference — issues together with the certificate of incorporation (law rule hk.business-registration-certificate). ([IRD — business registration](https://www.ird.gov.hk/eng/tax/bre.htm))

<a id="geo-ee"></a>

### Estonia

- Absorbed: The tax identity arrives with formation: the registry code (registrikood) is assigned on entry in the commercial register and identifies the company to the Tax and Customs Board; a separate VAT number comes only with VAT registration (law rule [ee.vat-registration-threshold](../../open-law/EE/ee-vat-registration-threshold.json)). ([e-Business Register](https://ariregister.rik.ee/eng))
- Step 2: Absorbed: The tax identity arrives with formation: the registry code (registrikood) is assigned on entry in the commercial register and identifies the company to the Tax and Customs Board; a separate VAT number comes only with VAT registration (law rule ee.vat-registration-threshold). ([e-Business Register](https://ariregister.rik.ee/eng))
